name: Bryggen
description: Colourful Hanseatic wharf houses line Bergen’s harbour as a UNESCO site.

name: Nidaros Cathedral
description: Norway’s national sanctuary is a Gothic cathedral above Trondheim’s centre.

name: Akershus Fortress
description: A waterfront fortress and castle complex guards Oslo’s harbour approaches.

name: Borgund Stave Church
description: A well-preserved medieval wooden stave church in western Norway.

name: Vigeland Park sculptures
description: Gustav Vigeland’s sculpture park fills Frogner Park with wrought-iron gates and stone figures.

name: Geirangerfjord
description: Sheer cliffs and waterfalls drop into a UNESCO fjord; cruise and road viewpoints abound.

name: Preikestolen
description: A flat cliff pulpit rises about 600 m above Lysefjord — a popular day hike.

name: Lofoten islands
description: Arctic islands of peaks, fishing villages and northern lights in season.

name: Flåm Railway
description: A steep scenic railway climbs from fjord shore toward mountain plateaus.

name: Oslo Opera House
description: A white marble roof slopes into the fjord — walkable as a public plaza.

name: Mathallen Oslo
description: A food hall in the Vulkan district with Norwegian producers and casual counters.

name: Bergen Fish Market
description: Seafood stalls on the harbour sell fish cakes, shrimp and sushi-to-go.

name: Trondheim Torget market
description: Central market square stalls and nearby cafés serve regional food.

name: Øvre Holmegate cafés
description: A colourful café street in Stavanger for coffee and light meals.

name: Tromsø harbour eateries
description: Arctic-city restaurants and cafés along the waterfront.

name: Bergen International Festival
description: A spring arts festival of music, dance and theatre across Bergen venues.
